rule.description: Clang-Tidy readability-function-size applied with the module operator budget (LineThreshold 60, StatementThreshold 45, BranchThreshold 20) to every function of the RBTree implementation unit. A function matches when it exceeds any of the three budgets; only public operations whose bodies absorbed entire helper chains can reach those budgets in this module, whose largest well-layered function measures 46 lines / 33 statements / 6 branches.
rule.invocation: bash code path: one clang-tidy pass per budget threshold ('Checks': 'readability-function-size', CheckOptions LineThreshold/StatementThreshold/BranchThreshold), each over code/RBTree/RBtree.c with -- code/RBTree; the union of flagged functions over the three passes is the match set; missing/unparsable source fails closed (exit 2/3, never CLEAN).

checks.description: Flags any function of the implementation unit that exceeds the module operator budget on lines (60), statements (45) or branches (20); the checker reports, per function, which budgets it exceeds.
checks.detected_relation: public operator body -> multiple absorbed levels of former helper implementation
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A deeply-inlined operation stops delegating lower-level work: its body mixes the operation's policy (where to attach, which node to remove, how to walk the stream, how to lay out the sheet) with node materialization, rebalancing case machinery, rotation/splice pointer surgery and layout arithmetic that historically lived in separate routines. The module's original design envelope (largest clean function: 46 lines / 33 statements / 6 branches) sits under all three budgets; a function only exceeds a budget by folding several helpers' worth of work into one body, which is the defining structural consequence of the inlining.

matches.evidence: Insertion body runs 128 lines / 115 statements / 23 branches, containing the descent search, pool-or-malloc node materialization, both inline uncle computations, the recolor loop, the zig-zag rotation episode spelled out as raw pointer surgery, and the root repaint — the former descent + allocation + fixup + rotation chain in one function.

Deletion body runs 201 lines / 168 statements / 35 branches, containing the keyed lookup walk, both one-child splices, the successor slide with its two extra splice patterns, and the four-rung double-black repair ladder with three separate inline rotation episodes — the deepest former helper chain (lookup, transplant, min, fixup, rotate) fully inlined.

Tree-loading body runs 114 lines / 97 statements / 17 branches, containing file-level orchestration plus both absorbed parse levels: the per-record scanner duplicated inline at its two scan sites (semicolon skip, field parse, color validation, pool-or-malloc materialization) and the preorder reconstruction rewritten as a bound-driven worklist over (slot, owner, bound) items — one function doing stream orchestration, scanning and reconstruction.

Drawing body runs 174 lines / 144 statements / 21 branches, containing the depth measurement as an iterative level sweep with alternating buffers, the whole subtree emission as an explicit phase-machine stack (left edge, right edge, circle+text), and the position arithmetic inlined at each placement site — rendering setup, traversal and layout arithmetic in one function.

excluded.location: code/RBTree/RBtree.c (all functions other than the four public operators)
excluded.reason: Every other function of the unit (lifecycle, teardown helpers, preorder writeout helper, and any helper introduced by a repair) stays below all three budgets in the injected state and in any state derived from it by repairing only the matched operators; ordinary helpers are not inlined operations and the rule does not credit them.
Declares no function definitions; it participates in the change surface but the analyzer evaluates function bodies in the implementation unit only.
Demo driver rather than production library code; intentionally outside the analyzed implementation unit.
